description: Plan v7 section 8.3's 'missing keys containing placeholders and failure-key fail-soft behavior', measured against the interpolated-output limit. DefaultStrings.interpolateFailureKey interpolates the KEY under maximumInterpolatedOutputCharacters and wraps the whole thing in try/catch(RuntimeException) { return key; }, so an overflow there silently degrades to the raw key instead of propagating. The catalog holds one unrelated key so the fixture loads; every case looks up a key that is deliberately absent.
